narrative.overview: Helix back-office reads like a registry kept after hours: dark, exact, and unhurried. Every surface is built so a routine task finishes before attention drifts. The shell is off-black, content sits on near-black cards separated by 1px hairlines, and a single electric blue marks what can be acted on.
keyCharacteristics: Off-black shell (#141414), near-black cards (#0a0a0a), 1px hairlines. No pure #000 shell.
One accent: signal blue (#0a7cff dark / #0072f5 light). Everything else is neutral.
Glass only on floating chrome: cards on glass, bottom nav, sheets, drawers.
Thai-first type stack with correct line height for vowel and tone marks.
Press feedback everywhere: tappable surfaces scale to 95% on active.
Light theme exists and mirrors the dark tokens; dark is the default for staff.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Blue is the only accent in staff screens. If a second hue is needed for meaning, it is a status color, never decoration.

rules.name: The Subject Hue Exception
rules.body: Subject chips and timetable cards use a per-learning-area hue with three grade shades. This is a data encoding, not a palette; it stays out of chrome.

rules.name: The 16px Input Rule
rules.body: Inputs are 16px on phones to stop iOS zoom, and drop to 14px at 768px and above.

rules.name: The Thai Leading Rule
rules.body: Never set line-height below 1.25 on Thai text; tone marks and upper vowels clip.

rules.name: The Float-Only Rule
rules.body: Blur and heavy shadow mark things above the page. Tables, lists, and in-page panels do not get them.

dos: Do keep staff screens dark by default with the off-black shell (#141414), never pure #000.
Do use signal blue for focus and the single main action only.
Do put glass on floating chrome only.
Do keep Thai text at line-height 1.25 or more.
Do keep tappable surfaces pressable with the 95% scale response.
Do keep the student portal a separate `.theme-game` skin.
donts: Don't put gradient text or decorative gradients on staff chrome.
Don't add a second accent hue to the back-office.
Don't apply blur or heavy shadow to tables and in-page panels.
Don't reuse the game skin's pink, thick borders, or press shadow in staff screens.
Don't use the Overcooked-style hard-shadow comic look; it was tried and discarded for the student portal.
